justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, typed JobState and QueueError enums cover the main domain distinctions, though the internal Job uses an Option<Instant> for retry_at where state-specific data could be modeled into the JobState variants.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with two distinguishing variants, Display implemented, no unwraps in library paths and the single expect has a clear reason after a just-located lookup.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with doc comments on every public item, sensible derives on JobId and JobState, Display on QueueError, and naming consistent with std conventions.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, ok_or, map, and saturating/checked arithmetic, but the checkout loop uses an imperative scan with a mutable Option instead of an iterator chain like find.
